description: NOT available on this connection: returns host_authored_image_plan_required with no request made, nothing quoted and nothing charged. This MCP connection does not start Soclo-funded AI planning, and it must not be started silently on the account owner’s behalf. soclo_host_plan_prepare does not return a frames contract. For a host-authored still use soclo_image_generate with your own scene prompt. Use soclo_image_frames only if an existing compatible Soclo shot plan already supplied its planId and complete frames quote. The owner can choose native planning in the Soclo app.
